title: A page load on the notification centre with a backlog renders the backlog at load without re-announcing every notification into the polite queue
asA: screen-reader user opening a notification centre with an existing backlog
iWant: the backlog to appear on the surface at load without a flood of announcements into the polite live region
soThat: opening the centre after a long absence does not saturate the assistive-technology announcement queue

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a page load on the notification centre route with a backlog of unacknowledged notifications from the retention window, the DOM contains one wrapper per backlog notification with `data-notification-id` on each; the polite wrapper `[data-live-region="polite"]` remains empty at load (no backlog announcement); the assertive wrapper `[data-live-region="assertive"]` remains empty at load. A centre implementation that pushes every backlog item into the polite queue on load is a defect.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a page load on the centre route with a backlog
acceptanceCriteria.when: the initial DOM and the live-region wrappers are read
acceptanceCriteria.then: the backlog is rendered on the surface and neither live-region wrapper carries a load-time announcement
